question.text: If InvIT units are not listed or money is not refunded within the specified time, what rate of interest per annum must the InvIT pay?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under InvIT Regulations, InvITs shall pay interest at 15% per annum from the closure of the issue in case the units are not listed or the money is not refunded within the specified time. The Trap: 12% and 18% are common interest rates in other financial contexts but the InvIT regulation specifies exactly 15%. Note: The same 15% per annum rate applies to REITs in the comparable situation.
